profile.name: 电动位移执行器
profile.description: 一种用于实验室自动定位与扫描的电动运动装置，可驱动样品、探头或光学元件沿一个或多个轴进行绝对移动、相对移动、回零和停止，并返回当前位置与轴信息。常见形式包括电动位移台、旋转台或其他机电执行器，常用于对准、扫描和自动化测量。
profile.description_en: A motorized motion device used for laboratory positioning and scanning. It can move samples, probes, or optical components along one or more axes with absolute moves, relative moves, homing, and stop control, while reporting current position and axis information. Typical examples include motorized translation stages, rotation stages, and other electromechanical actuators used for alignment, scanning, and automated measurements.

registry.name: National Instruments DAQ Move
registry.description: DAQ Move是由National Instruments生产的物流/机械，主要功能包括停止、关闭、初始化、设备连接、设置、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, actuator等操作。
